scope: Read-only/noanalysis Ghidra exports plus independent raw-PE and installed DDF/HDR assertions. No original installation edits or original runtime execution.

proved.meaning: Upgrade factor0x25 (CityRadius) exposes UnitAbilityAreaEffectCity+34 as its mutable native float; getter007D9CC0 returns the same field.

Lifecycle eventkind4/subkind0,1,2 with unit+58>0 calls008153F0(unit,ability+34) directly. No extra scale multiplication is present at this call site. Raw event numeric codes are not assigned unproved completion/load names.
CityInfo serializes current m_Radius at+8 and history array+0C/count+10. Each eight-byte pair is explicitly m_GameTime(first float),m_CityRadius(second float). It is not an abstract priority array.

Global point query checks every stored history radius with strict L1 distance<radius*1.4142135381698608. For overlapping entries it prefers the oldest matching game time and then the lowest center-unit ID. The decal only tests whether the result is nonzero, so tie priority does not affect urban/rural choice.

New CityInfo stores supplied radius bits unscaled at+8 (0081546D), initializes bounds, and calls00814FA0. Existing record is reused with its stored radius, not overwritten by a smaller registration argument.

Radius setter writes raw new radius to+8 (00814FDF); sqrt2 conversion is for spatial-grid bounds. An empty history receives a pair; otherwise append only if new radius is strictly greater than last historical radius. Pair is game-time float then radius float.
Native update obtains abilitytype0x10 and compares ability+34 to CityInfo+8. It invokes00814FA0 only for a strictly larger value. Normal radius updates preserve the lifetime maximum and never shrink.
Removal unlinks hash/grid and pending border work, calls CityInfo cleanup008127F0 at008157C4, then frees record through00A183B0 at008157CA. A new record is a new lifetime.

Pointer replacement unlinks the old ID bucket, changes only centerUnit pointer+3C, and rehashes under the new unit ID. Stored radius/history/originalOwner remain. This routine is not labeled a generic ownership/capture callback without lifecycle enum proof.

remainingUnproved: Exact symbolic mapping of native lifecycle eventkind/subkind numeric constants, including every city-emitter ability and replacement path.
Complete native CityManager ownership, timestamp/tie-selected CityInfo and animated border rendering are not reproduced by the boolean completed-TC registration adapter.
Non-BASE/civilization CityRadius upgrades are not imported into this adapter.
conclusion: Raw world radius, strict native point arithmetic, registration/reuse/removal, retained replacement history and monotone lifetime updates are now proved. A persistent high-water scalar suffices for urbanBool of each currently registered TC; completed-TC registration remains a bounded adapter, not full CityManager equivalence.
